~Oðlkpna
Oðlkpna is Earth-like planet orbit around gaseous planet Ltaekopy, home to single advanced civilization in mysterious violet spiral galaxy. It has carbon-based lifeform. Planet is most envied by other extraterrestrial civilizations, it has extreme abundance of other elements from neutron star. Atmosphere is composed nitrogen, oxygen, asole dioxide, trace neon. Atmosphere is lavender-colored due to presence of asole dioxide. Ocean is primarily composed of water, with small quantities of salt and asole dissolved within it. Ocean appears dark violet due to presence of asole. Lavender color of clouds is caused by small amount of asole, which is created when ocean’s asolewater evaporates.
Ltaekopy is third Springian gaseous giant orbits around GV2-type star Keloafv, it has gray ring from rocky planet destroyed by its Roche limit, it has aerial lifeforms. Oðlkpna is second planet orbits it. 45 asteroids orbit it. 1st, 3rd, 4th, 5th are rocky planets orbit it.

They can see colors are red, green, blue, ultraviolet, same as ahmuivns from fascist planet Frenya. They are Mithridatistic and athletic.
Economy is communist, anti-economic, moneyless. Copyrights, properties and money are illegal and should be abolished, but copylefts are embraced, communism is embraced and capitalism is forbidden in law. Oðlkpnab culture embrace sex, religious practices, nudity, luxuries. Sex is preventing rebellion under our empire. Pangamy is valued, monogamy and jealousy are forbidden in law. Law allowed consent/sexual engage with minors, but sexual abuse (and rape, molestation) are absolutely forbidden in law, law helps to prevent minors from harming.

It is being center of attention, chatty, assertive, dominant, confident, scientific, physically strong. It have no emotions, but joyful in mood. It’s polygamous and pansexual, it likes sexual engage and kiss. It created new our empire and dominated world after it started revolution during viruses are infecting world and wanting extinction of lnpbeqav, viruses are defeated and eradicated.
Luxury is valued in architecture, building, construction in Oðlkpnab Imperium, embrace delicious and luxurious. Sexuoyx and tungsten carbide are material used in building and construction. Delicious and luxurious are embraced. Our empire don’t need cities of suburban and rural, our empire enforces communal apartments, ensuring conformity. Bathrooms and restrooms have glass door of enter/exit. In restroom, around the toilets, it have no planes and doors, ensuring lack of privacy. Our intergalactic spiritualist empire named Oðlkpnab Imperium, commanded under divine polyarchic theocracy and sexual appeals ruled by deities. Democracy and anarchy seen as threat to our empire. Individuality and rebellions are suppressed, fall into communal life. Rules are no privacy, no family, no monogamy. Recreational drug is invented, making they more loyal.

Overall, you have created a compelling and imaginative world. With further development, the Oðlkpnab Imperium could become a truly remarkable fictional universe.

更深层的问题在于：现有的经验（如经验1强调事实一致性）在此处适用，但评分标准的**设计逻辑**有缺陷。Judge在评判时，对于'chosen'（评论型回答）判为0分，是因为它没有满足‘生成初稿（即整理设定）’的任务要求，但现有的Rubric criteria（如Criterion 7, 8...）只检查内容点是否存在，没有检查‘任务类型匹配度’（即：用户给了设定，你是否在整理？还是你在写评论？）。
